name: Alphastar
note: Version 1.0.82 / build 83 moves Medical Forms History to Profile > Account and Keep Your Records Safe to the Form landing page, titled Medical Form. Student and Non-student options expand in one connected selector; patient type is not repeated in the editor. White inputs fit the page with labels inside their top-left corners. Next, Back and Submit scroll with the form. Built-in form help uses the updated names and navigation. Existing drafts, submitted forms, photos, PDF templates, previous forms, results and conversations are preserved; no backend, data reset or database-rule deployment is included. Existing development/test signing certificate retained; not Play Store or production-signing approval. Install over a compatible existing app without uninstalling or clearing app data. Physical-phone installation and actual patient push delivery were not verified.
